local_review.finding_body: The resolved dynamic-access evidence identifies call sites in both MethodMonitorRegistry and EnhancedClassDataReflectiveImpl, but the contribution originally placed both scenarios in MethodMonitorRegistryTest.java. This violated FS-test-contract.1.8, which requires a dedicated test file for each dynamic-access class.
local_review.finding_title: Dynamic-access classes combined in one test file
local_review.fix_note: Moved the reflective class-data scenario and its helper types into EnhancedClassDataReflectiveImplTest.java while retaining the MethodMonitorRegistry resource-bundle scenario and all assertions. This restores the required one-file-per-dynamic-access-class mapping without weakening coverage.
local_review.review_comment: Checked the single-coordinate diff against the new-library review rules and contribution contract: the tests exercise public library behavior without scaffold code, version pinning, package bypasses, Native Image skips, compatibility overrides, or legacy metadata files. Reported dynamic-access coverage is 5/5 (100%), and 5 covered calls do not trigger the mismatch probe against 9 reported library-plus-test metadata entries. The repaired tree passed the exact Forge finalization command unchanged across all three native lanes, metadata splitting and validation, style checks, generated-test validation, and statistics generation.
